_README: SMOKE config: proves the whole chain works end to end for a few real sessions before
you commit to a full campaign. One arm, three designs, one sample each = 3 sessions.
The credential NEVER goes in this file. It comes from the environment (.env).
Once this passes, scale up with sweep.config.example.json.
ARTIFACTS: on by default, written to .eval-runs/smoke-v1/artifacts/. Note that samples
already in results.jsonl are SKIPPED on a re-run (that is what stops a resume re-paying),
so a sample recorded before artifacts existed will not grow them retroactively. To
capture evidence for those, run into a fresh outputDir/runName.
